summary: 排查并彻底解决 OpenClaw Control UI 在 HA Ingress (8099) 与 LAN 直连 (18789) 模式下的加载缓慢与首次登录卡顿问题，实现 22ms 毫秒级极速打开。
commands: POST http://supervisor/dns/options {"fallback": false} && docker restart hassio_dns
配置 Nginx 接管 /usr/local/lib/node_modules/openclaw/dist/control-ui/ 静态资源直出 + gzip_comp_level 6 + immutable 强缓存
配置 Nginx sub_filter 注入免密自动连接脚本并移除对大体积 JS 的 sub_filter_types 缓冲
docker exec -u node app_3dc2fc14_openclaw nginx -s reload && docker commit app_3dc2fc14_openclaw 3dc2fc14/aarch64-addon-openclaw:2026.9.24.1

verification_evidence.lan_static_js_latency: dns: 0.0025s, connect: 0.0056s, starttransfer: 0.0140s, total: 0.0220s (22ms), size: 84242 bytes (gzipped from ~310KB)
verification_evidence.ingress_dns_latency: 从 2.04s 降至 0.004s (关闭 hassio_dns DoT fallback 超时)
verification_evidence.browser_e2e_check: Title: main — OpenClaw, Path: /chat/main, 自动免密进入主会话

next_steps: 用户可直接在 Home Assistant 侧边栏点击 OpenClaw 图标或访问 http://192.168.1.66:18789/ 秒开进入会话
